questions.text: Select the correct Passive Voice form of the sentence: "They will have completed the project by next Friday."

options.label: A
options.text: The project will be completed by them by next Friday.

options.label: B
options.text: The project would have been completed by them by next Friday.

options.label: C
options.text: The project will have been completed by them by next Friday.

options.label: D
options.text: The project is completed by them by next Friday.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Tense preservation rule. Active Future Perfect (will have + V3) converts to Passive Future Perfect (will have been + V3). Eliminate options changing tense: 'will be' (Simple Future), 'would have been' (Conditional), 'is' (Present). Only option with 'will have been' is correct. Step-by-step: 1. Identify Active tense: Future Perfect ('will have completed'). 2. Apply rule: Object becomes Subject ('The project'). 3. Add 'be' form matching tense: 'will have been'. 4. Add V3 of main verb ('completed'). 5. Add 'by' + Agent ('by them'). 6. Retain time phrase ('by next Friday').

questions.text: Choose the word which best expresses the meaning of the given phrase: "A person who believes in the existence of God"
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use prefix elimination. 'A-' means 'without/not'. 'Theist' comes from Greek 'theos' (God). So, A-theist = No God (incorrect). A-gnostic = No knowledge (incorrect). Pan-theist = All is God (incorrect). Theist = Believer in God (correct). Step-by-step: 1. Identify root 'theos' = God. 2. Analyse prefixes: 'A-' negates (Atheist, Agnostic). 'Pan-' means all (Pantheist). 3. Only 'Theist' directly denotes belief in God without negation or expansion.

questions.text: A train 150 metres long passes a pole in 12 seconds. How much time will it take to pass a platform 350 metres long?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Speed = 150/12 = 12.5 m/s. Total distance = 150 + 350 = 500 m. Time = 500/12.5 = 40 s. Full: Compute speed from pole crossing, then time = (train length + platform length) / speed.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'She is the only daughter of the only son of my grandfather.' How is the woman in the photograph related to the man?
questions.solution: Shortcut: The only son of the man's grandfather is his father; the only daughter of that father is the man's sister. Step-by-step: Grandfather's only son = man's father. Father's only daughter = man's sister. Hence the woman is his sister.

questions.text: Deficiency of Vitamin D in growing children leads to which disease?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Match Vitamin-Disease pairs. Vit C -> Scurvy, Vit B1 -> Beri-Beri, Vit A -> Night Blindness, Vit D -> Rickets (children) / Osteomalacia (adults). Worked Solution: Vitamin D is essential for calcium absorption and bone mineralization. Its deficiency in children causes defective bone growth leading to Rickets, characterized by bowed legs and deformed ribs. In adults, the same deficiency causes Osteomalacia.

questions.text: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'. The new recruit is not accustomed with the rigorous training schedule of the academy.

options.label: C
options.text: rigorous training schedule of the academy

questions.solution: Shortcut: Adjective-Preposition Collocation. 'Accustomed' always takes 'to', not 'with'. Remember pair: 'Accustomed to' (habituated). 'With' is used for 'Angry with', 'Busy with', 'Fed up with'. Spot 'accustomed with' -> Error. Step-by-step: 1. Scan segments for standard collocation errors. 2. Segment B contains 'accustomed with'. 3. Rule: The adjective 'accustomed' requires the preposition 'to' (e.g., accustomed to the noise). 4. 'With' is incorrect here. 5. Segments A and C are grammatically sound.

questions.text: Statements: All Pens are Books. Some Books are Pencils. No Pencil is Eraser. Conclusions: I. Some Pens are Pencils. II. No Book is Eraser. III. Some Books are not Erasers. Which conclusion(s) logically follow(s)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Apply 'Some + No = Some Not' rule. Since Some Books are Pencils and No Pencil is Eraser, those Books which are Pencils are not Erasers -> Conclusion III follows. I and II are possibilities, not certainties. Step-by-step: Draw minimal Venn diagram. Pens inside Books. Books overlap Pencils. Pencils separate from Erasers. I: Pens may not touch Pencils. II: Books outside Pencils could be Erasers. III: The overlapping part of Books and Pencils is definitely not Eraser.

questions.text: By which Constitutional Amendment Act were the Fundamental Duties added to the Constitution of India?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 42nd Amendment (Mini Constitution, 1976) added Part IV-A (Art 51A) on Swaran Singh Committee recommendation. 44th reversed emergency provisions. 86th added Art 21A (Education). 73rd gave constitutional status to Panchayats. Worked Solution: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 (during Emergency) added a new Part IV-A to the Constitution consisting of Article 51A which prescribes ten Fundamental Duties for citizens, based on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.

questions.text: Who among the following founded the Vijayanagara Empire in 1336 AD?

options.label: A
options.text: Harihara I and Bukka Raya I

questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate rulers of other dynasties. Krishnadevaraya was a later famous ruler (Tuluva dynasty), Muhammad bin Tughlaq and Alauddin Khalji were Delhi Sultans. The Sangama dynasty founders Harihara I and Bukka Raya I established the empire. Worked Solution: The Vijayanagara Empire was established in 1336 CE by the brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I of the Sangama Dynasty, on the southern banks of the Tungabhadra River.

questions.text: A can complete a piece of work in 10 days and B can complete the same work in 15 days. They work on alternate days, starting with A. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Take LCM of 10 and 15 = 30 units. A's efficiency = 3 units/day, B's = 2 units/day. In 2 days they complete 5 units. 30/5 = 6 cycles → 12 days. Full: A does 1/10 per day, B 1/15 per day. Two days work = 1/6. 6 such pairs = 1 work in 12 days.

questions.text: An article is sold at a profit of 20%. If both the cost price and selling price are reduced by ₹100, the profit percentage becomes 25%. Find the original cost price of the article.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Let CP = x. Original SP = 1.2x. New CP = x−100, new SP = 1.2x−100. Profit 25% → 1.2x−100 = 1.25(x−100). Solving gives 0.05x = 25 → x = 500. Full: Set up the equation as above and solve for x.

questions.text: The Tehri Dam, the highest dam in India, is constructed on which river?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Tehri is in Uttarakhand on the Bhagirathi river (headstream of Ganga). Alaknanda hosts Vishnuprayag dam projects, Yamuna has Lakhwar-Vyasi. Worked Solution: Tehri Dam is a multi-purpose rock and earth-fill embankment dam on the Bhagirathi River near Tehri in Uttarakhand. It is the primary dam of the THDC India Ltd. and the highest dam in India with a height of 260.5 metres.

questions.text: Select the related letter cluster from the given alternatives. HOUSE : SLFHV :: TRAIN : ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Recognise the Atbash cipher (reverse alphabet) where each letter is replaced by its opposite (A↔Z, B↔Y… sum of positions = 27). Write the reverse alphabet below the normal one for instant mapping. Step-by-step: Verify pattern with HOUSE: H(8)→S(19), O(15)→L(12), U(21)→F(6), S(19)→H(8), E(5)→V(22); all pairs sum to 27. Apply to TRAIN: T(20)→G(7), R(18)→I(9), A(1)→Z(26), I(9)→R(18), N(13)→M(14) giving GIZRM.

questions.text: A sum of money becomes 1.44 times itself in 2 years at compound interest compounded annually. What is the annual rate of interest?
Select the number that replaces the question mark (?) in the following analogy: 8 : 63 :: 11 : ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Check relationship 8^2 - 1 = 63. Apply same to 11: 11^2 - 1 = 120. Step-by-step: The pattern is First Number squared minus 1. 8 * 8 = 64, 64 - 1 = 63. Similarly, 11 * 11 = 121, 121 - 1 = 120.
